question: RAG 시스템에서 query rewriting, reranking, corrective retrieval, self-reflective retrieval 기법은 검색 품질과 답변의 faithfulness를 어떤 조건에서 개선하며, latency·비용·구현 복잡도 측면에서 어떤 trade-off를 만드는가?

scope.population: English-language research about retrieval-augmented generation systems

inclusion_criteria: Published or publicly released from 2020-01-01 through the run date
English title and abstract or legally accessible full text
Directly evaluates at least one in-scope RAG intervention or a necessary component
Primary research reports methods, data, metrics, or direct experimental results
At least one DOI, arXiv ID, or Semantic Scholar paperId can be verified
exclusion_criteria: Blog, marketing page, unattributed document, or search-result snippet as core evidence
Survey used as a substitute for primary experimental evidence
Non-English paper without an English abstract
Paywall, robots policy, or access control must be bypassed
Identifier remains invalid or unresolved after bounded verification
search_timestamp_policy: Record UTC timestamp at each source request and at run start
interpretation_policy: Agent interpretations and hypotheses must use separate fields and must not be attributed to paper authors
